findings.remediation: The transaction context records its exact active flock descriptor and every fixed subprocess receives only that descriptor through pass_fds. If Runtime dies, a surviving Docker CLI keeps the same exclusive lock alive; recovery remains ACTIVATION_TRANSACTION_BUSY until the CLI completes, after which recovery freshly observes and quiesces the final Docker state. A real parent-kill POSIX regression proves the contender remains blocked while the child lives and succeeds only after child exit.
